case.query: I have two separate questions: My ankles are swollen with fluid; what are some common causes for this type of swelling besides heart failure? I've been diagnosed with HIV; what is the main goal of taking antiretroviral therapy medicines every day?
evidence: Causes of edema include: Eating too much salt Sunburn Heart failure Kidney disease Liver problems from cirrhosis Pregnancy Problems with lymph nodes , especially after mastectomy Some medicines Standing or walking a lot when the weather is warm To keep swelling down, your health care provider may recommend keeping your legs raised when sitting, wearing support stockings, limiting how much salt you eat, or taking a medicine called a diuretic - also called a water pill.
The medicines do not cure HIV infection, but help people with HIV live longer, healthier lives.
